E.measurement → sol 2: the protocol says each K-way ranking becomes pairwise comparisons, but every system scores 3.4–13.5 at K=4, far below the 50% chance of per-comparison accuracy, so the reported metric is not the one described (opus:O04). E.causality → sol 2 (store-off on the test benchmarks is the bare sub-agent row; no Claude-written non-feedback library, gate-off or skills-vs-tools arm; same-pipeline FlowGRPO comparison).
